title: Canonical ordinary etale signed twists and unit-Chern decomposition map
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, $N\in\mathbf N$ with $NA=0$, and $T$ a scheme in universe $u$. Use the ordinary small etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and finite signed Tate sheaves [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf]. Define $A_T(a)[b]$ to be the degree-zero embedding of the signed Tate sheaf $A_T(a)$ followed by shift $b$, for all integers $a,b$. For the following map assume $N>0$ and $N$ invertible on a scheme $S$, and put $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For any arrow $c:A_P\to A_P(1)[2]$, define $d(c):A_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\to Rq_*A_P$ as the ordered coproduct of the ordinary adjunction unit and the adjunct of the composite $q^*(A_S(-1)[-2])\cong q^*(A_S(-1)[-2])\otimes_A^L A_P\xrightarrow{1\otimes c}q^*(A_S(-1)[-2])\otimes_A^L A_P(1)[2]\to A_P$. Here the last arrow is the canonical roots-normalized negative-twist pullback, cancellation of the shifts, tensor symmetry, and the internal-Hom evaluation of the dual Tate line against the positive line [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. This defines the map for the supplied $c$ and asserts neither Kummer normalization nor invertibility, and assumes no Noetherianity.

lean.statement:
def p1DecompositionMap (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S ⊞ p1DecompositionTwist A N hA S (-1) (-2)) ⟶
      (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S))
